content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts consistently overestimate prices, especially during high supply events.", "Sentiment shifts inversely correlate with forecast accuracy, particularly when bullish sentiment is absent.", "Forecast bias is amplified during periods of high event frequency and negative supply net.", "Mean-reversion patterns emerge when sentiment is neutral and supply is stable.", "Overshoots are common in early forecast windows when sentiment is bullish but supply is rising.", "Model accuracy declines when sentiment is uniformly flat and historical volatility is low.", "Forecast lag increases with rising bearish sentiment and declining recent price momentum.", "Corrective adjustments should prioritize supply net and sentiment direction over historical mean."] }
